# Global and within-row candidate loop controls

Author: @radialmonster
Verified by: @radialmonster
Lead: #638
Variant: unassigned
Builds on: #31, #11, #284

## Claim
For the fixed candidate-token loop comparison on two previously studied files at 300 nominal rows, changing from within-row to global mapped-prefix shuffles changes the count of cells meeting the descriptive 1.5 range-ratio threshold on 1993, but not 5283. This does not identify physical rows, a predictor or the private historical estimator.

## Original evidence
At commit 6b93ea99efd33fcfc02f871ce681004da8b29dd9, #638 reported within/global threshold counts 0/12 and 2/12 on 1993, and 0/12 and 0/12 on 5283.

## Verification
After the lead was published, fresh runs reproduced both original cases in both modes and tested 600 nominal rows on those files and the predeclared 1995 and 6343. All are previously studied public CC0 files, not blind captures; the same human verified them. An independent bit parser and cumulative-loop implementation matched all four primary integer loops, all three mappings and every real and null range, as well as token/end/escape and identity metadata. Both implementations share the TIFF locator. Secondary R1/R2/LK05/LK09 outputs were not independently recomputed. All requested prefixes completed.

The threshold is 8 times the real range at least 3 times the sum of four null ranges, when the sum is positive. It is descriptive rather than a significance test.

| 1993 | 300 | 0 / 12 | 2 / 12 | 9574636 | 1 |

| 5283 | 600 | 0 / 12 | 0 / 12 | 21813760 | 3751 |
| 1995 | 600 | 0 / 12 | 2 / 12 | 19145858 | 1 |
| 6343 | 600 | 0 / 12 | 0 / 12 | 20761193 | 411 |

## Reproduce

At commit 6b93ea99efd33fcfc02f871ce681004da8b29dd9, verify the retained public CC0 record and hash for each file, then run both modes for each file:

```text
python -I -B tools/token_loop_probe.py --sample ID PUBLIC_NAME FILE --rows 300 --perms 4 --null-mode within-row
python -I -B tools/token_loop_probe.py --sample ID PUBLIC_NAME FILE --rows 300 --perms 4 --null-mode global
```

The fixed inputs are 1993 Olympus - E-M1MarkII - 16bit (4:3).ORF, SHA-256 0b433019e5fa61548d7eb0eb7bb90894251542c056da72355202382696d0ceb8; and 5283 OM System - OM-1 - 16bit (4:3).ORF, SHA-256 bf2eef6becc0851e48231617c3e2eac27a2cdb44c75b93035c561d837952c18b. Seed = 20261021 + 1000*ID + 10*mapping_index + permutation_index, with mapping indices 0..2 and permutation indices 0..3. Candidate q>=17 tokens remain in the parse with no extra escape skip.


For the wider cases use `--rows 600` for both modes. Public additional inputs: 1995 Olympus - E-M1MarkII - 16bit (4:3).ORI, SHA-256 8af918366ed969c6dddf5a48b8810fec1024858d22c75c5f1ac1a5c750a57a1f; 6343 OM System - OM-5 - 16bit (4:3).ORF, SHA-256 ee0213ee4899d677d9bd538d8cfa4d0f69bdbacd462c1cf3ca3901036cf2fce7. Verify names against the manifest and retained CC0 records before use.

## Limitations
Within-row shuffling preserves each nominal row's mapped-value multiset; global shuffling changes row allocation and multiple structures at once. Four permutations do not calibrate significance. The candidate parsing, mappings and row geometry are assumptions; this does not reproduce #31's private estimator or establish codec syntax, sensor values or a predictor. Independently justified framing and loop/value assumptions remain open.
